name: hexadecanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, sixteen-carbon, saturated long-chain fatty acid.

roles_classification.name: plant metabolite
roles_classification.definition: Any eukaryotic metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in plants, the kingdom that include flowering plants, conifers and other gymnosperms.

roles_classification.name: Daphnia magna metabolite
roles_classification.definition: A Daphnia metabolite produced by the species Daphnia magna.

roles_classification.name: algal metabolite
roles_classification.definition: Any eukaryotic metabolite produced during a metabolic reaction in algae including unicellular organisms like chlorella and diatoms to multicellular organisms like giant kelps and brown algae.

roles_classification.name: EC 1.1.1.189 (prostaglandin-E2 9-reductase) inhibitor
roles_classification.definition: An EC 1.1.1.* (oxidoreductase acting on donor CH-OH group, NAD<small><sup>+</small></sup> or NADP<small><sup>+</small></sup> acceptor) inhibitor that interferes with the action of prostaglandin-E<small><sub>2</sub></small> 9-reductase (EC 1.1.1.189).

roles_classification.name: Bronsted acid
roles_classification.definition: A molecular entity capable of donating a hydron to an acceptor (Brønsted base).
